crm_notes: Profile: mid-market ecommerce platform, 400 employees, heavy seasonal spikes (holiday windows) — support team 120 agents.
Primary ask: reduce AHT via succinct one-paragraph summaries + automated tagging to power routing + macros for refunds/escalations.
Latency targets: suggest tags/summaries visible to agent in <350ms (p95) — tolerates slightly higher for full-ticket summarization in background.
Throughput: baseline 20 concurrent agent sessions, spike readiness to handle ~200 suggestions/sec during peak hours.
Model preference: open to Redwood-curated open models; preference for quantized variants on Dedicated to control cost. Want fallback to cheaper variant under heavy load.
Tool-calling: need secure macro invocation from suggested actions (create refund, escalate to billing queue, add SLA tag). Requires RBAC + audit trail.
Security: must run inside VPC with KMS integration, retention policy override for PII fields, SOC2 type II in procurement checklist.
Quote objection: finance pushes back on committed spend vs. burst pricing. Suggested: initial 6-month Dedicated + cost-optimization review after POC.
Integration notes: Zendesk app manifest will need Zendesk review; Freshdesk considered as fallback, but current ops built on Zendesk triggers and macros.
Quote from Head of Support: "If we can cut wrap time by 30% while keeping tag precision >90% we can justify replacing our rules engine."
POC success criteria: 90%+ tag precision on top 10 categories, summary quality score avg >= 4/5 on random audit, system stable under 250rt/s replay.
Internal stakeholders: Head of Support (review), CTO (security & infra), Ops Lead (integration), Legal (DPA + retention).
Action items: get SSO metadata, provide sandbox app zip + install instructions, prepare load profile for 2-week replay (Ops to deliver sample).
summary: WillowBay is evaluating Redwood to replace brittle rule-based tagging and manual summaries in Zendesk. They need VPC/Dedicated deployment, fast summaries and auto-tags, and secure macro/tool-calls with audit logs. Primary concerns: SSO integration, Zendesk app approval, and predictable cost during seasonal spikes.
